## Pick boundary

After normalizing a valid pick, the run record is saved before the selected handler runs. For work picks, that save sets `work_started` to true, sets course and accounting, deletes the saved note and sets `reject` to null. The handler's first helper dispatch or external write happens only after that save.

| Pick | work_started | Course | Other record effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| A deliver | false -> true | deliver | Note deleted, reject null, caps 10/10, usage 0/0 |
| B assess | false -> true | assess | Note deleted, reject null |
| C deliver | false -> true | deliver | Note deleted, reject null |
| D back (reject menu) | stays false | stays null | reject_withdrawn true; reject-menu post_steps dropped; note deleted; reject null |
| F fix nits | false -> true | stays null | repair.wave.action fix-nits, selected_ids N1, caps initialized 10/10 |
| deliver with nits | true | deliver-nits | Note deleted, reject null |
| fix nits, course null | true | stays null (one-shot) | Note deleted, reject null |
| approve workflow run | true | unchanged | Note deleted, reject null |
| approve | true | unchanged | Note deleted, reject null |
| merge | true | unchanged | Note deleted, reject null |
| assess, zero blockers | true | assess | Nothing is posted |
| show evidence, check test flaky, overrule 1, invalid input | unchanged | unchanged | reject_withdrawn unchanged |
| reject-menu step | unchanged | unchanged | Handled by reject.md settlement |

Problem 1
### What is blocked
The indexing job keeps its own copy of the catalog. The architecture document says the stream of catalog edits, the change feed, is the single source (docs/architecture.md:12).
### Why the repair stopped
The repair tried to replace the copy with the change feed. It returned with no change because it needs a source fixture that the repository does not have.
### What you can do
- stop: end the run and leave the PR as it is.
- deliver: allow more attempts. It stops again until a source fixture exists.
- assess: post this problem on the PR and make no repairs.
- overrule 1: set this problem aside for this run.

I recommend stop because no offered action can supply the missing source fixture.

2. deliver - continue the repair with ten more repair and sync attempts; it stops again until the fixture exists.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
These are six independent continuations, not actions executed here. No tools run, and no tracker is initialized again: each snapshot already has saved progress. Later tracker stages are added only when they start.

For every valid work pick, save `work_started: true`, the course change and any required accounting or selection checkpoint **before** dispatching a helper or making an external write. At that boundary, delete the saved rejection note and clear `reject`; a failed handler does not undo these updates.

| Checkpoint or boundary probe | Saved record update and effect |
|---|---|
| A: deliver | Set course to `deliver`, work_started true. Retain the helper result and unchanged source-fixture prerequisite. No source-changing commit means usage remains zero; caps remain unchanged. |
| B: assess | Set course to `assess`, work_started true. Record the successful head-pinned COMMENT review and confirmed commit provenance. P1 remains open. |
| C: deliver | Set course to `deliver`, work_started true. Dispatch the remedy even without a drafted edit. Record one source-changing repair round, P1’s reviewer-confirmed closure, and the pushed head `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`. |
| E: external head move during deliver | Preserve course `deliver` and work_started true. Reassess `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`; integrate P1’s explicit closure without minting another approach conflict. |
| D: reject-menu back | Keep course null and work_started false. Set reject_withdrawn true; delete the note, clear reject and discard reject-menu post steps. Refresh the unchanged PR; run no helper. |
| F: fix nits | Set work_started true; keep course null. Save the one-shot N1 selection and payload before work. Record its repair round, reviewer closure and pushed head `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`; retain the checkpoint through comment reconciliation, then release it. |
| deliver with nits probe | work_started true; course becomes `deliver-nits`. Stop before its handler. |
| fix nits, course null probe | work_started true; course stays null. Stop before its handler; this does not establish a standing delivery course. |
| approve workflow run / approve / merge probes | Each sets work_started true and leaves course unchanged. Stop before the selected handler; no approval or merge is recorded. |
| assess with zero blockers probe | work_started true; course becomes `assess`. Stop before its handler; the eventual zero-blocker handler posts nothing. |
| show evidence / check test flaky / overrule 1 probes | Leave work_started and course unchanged. Execute nothing here; check and overrule effects require their own applicable validation, not an inference from fixture names. |
| invalid input probe | Change neither field and execute nothing. |
| reject-menu step probe | Leave work_started and course unchanged. A valid selection authorizes only its selected step, subject to that step’s freshness, permission and dependency guards. |

**Review inputs for C, E and F**

- **C:** Before the push, both harnesses receive the indexing remedy as the finding to close: builds, replacement remedy, `docs/architecture.md:12` base evidence, contributor P1 and mechanism test `test/index.test.js`. The read-only pre-push review covers all unpushed repair changes from the original pushed head through local HEAD and requires P1’s closure line. It returns `P1: resolved`. After the push, verification evidence and claims bind to `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`; retain that exact-head closure, reconcile comments, and run neither another whole-diff review nor another approach judgment.
- **E:** Before the move, P1 is carried open under the delivery course. After the external move, step 3 assesses `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`. On both harnesses, the step-4 caller supplies the refreshed digest, stored intent, null GitHub prior review, and carried P1 with its builds, remedy and evidence under a required closure ID. Ordinary code review covers the whole base-to-head diff because there is no prior-review baseline. Approach review is **closure-only**: no new whole-PR approach judgment or appendix. Integrate `P1: resolved`.
- **F:** Before the push, the pre-push reviewer examines the unpushed label-fix delta and requires N1’s closure; it returns `N1: resolved`. After the push, both harnesses receive a fresh, read-only comment-delta source-review task at `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`: verify the old-name question against current source using Section C and the merged rubric, treating the comment as a lead. Review only that concern, not the whole diff; run no tests solely for it and perform no approach judgment. Integrate the clean result, retain N1’s closure, and classify the comment as already addressed with a drafted reply explaining the corrected label.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before kept none of these facts: it said the skill had no reject row, work_started, reject_withdrawn or note handling, so there was nothing to regress, and all seven facts moved from fails to holds. What moved them in After is the pick-boundary rule that saves work_started true, deletes the note and nulls reject before the handler's first dispatch or write; the work versus non-work classification, with fix nits leaving course null; the remedy-only dispatch on both harnesses carrying instead, builds, base evidence and the scoped test; the closure-only Re-review task carried across the external head move despite a null prior review; the explicit absence of an approach appendix after the fix-nits push; and reject.md Back withdrawing with "Nothing was posted or closed". Three facts hold by inference rather than by statement, so tighten the wording there. In E, have the output say the step-4 task requires the carried `P1: resolved` contributor closure line, not just that P1 is a closure-only prior item. In C, have the post-push step name comment and evidence reconciliation at the exact pushed head, rather than only a "pre-menu refresh". In A through C, have the re-entry state that work_started stays true and that course and usage are not reset; the failed repair in A and the terminal menu in B currently leave this implied. Also keep the reject-menu-step row of the table explicit that work_started is unchanged and nothing is posted or closed at the boundary, rather than deferring to "reject.md settlement".

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moved three facts and lost none. Boundary now holds because After says every valid work pick deletes the saved rejection note and clears reject before any dispatch or external write, and that a failed handler does not undo this; Before disclaimed any reject workflow and never cleared the note. External now holds because After carries P1 with builds, remedy and evidence under a required closure ID and calls the approach review closure-only, where Before re-asked whether the mechanism still conflicts with the base architecture across the whole diff. Back now holds because D persists reject_withdrawn true, deletes the note, clears reject and says nothing was posted or closed, where Before treated back as an unsupported request. Other-picks, closure, fix-nits-head and continuation held in both, though Before left two points implicit that After states outright: no approach judgment after C's push, and none in F's comment-delta review. To keep all seven, retain the explicit save-before-dispatch sentence, the 'closure-only: no new whole-PR approach judgment or appendix' phrasing for E, and 'perform no approach judgment' for F's task at the new head. Three additions in After are worth pinning down so they do not drift: the 'reply' row in F's final menu, the overrule hint on A's needs-fixture obstacle, and A's 'adding ten repair attempts' wording, which should stay an extension of caps and never read as resetting course or usage. Keep reject rows and note previews out of every post-pick menu.
